events.text: Tigran Barseghyan (Slovan Bratislava) is shown the yellow card.
Goal! Roma 1, Slovan Bratislava 0. Mario Hermoso (Roma) header from very close range to the top left corner. Assisted by Daniele Ghilardi with a headed pass following a set piece situation.
Goal! Roma 2, Slovan Bratislava 0. Nahuel Molina (Roma) right footed shot from the right side of the six yard box to the bottom right corner.
First Half ends, Roma 2, Slovan Bratislava 0.
Second Half begins Roma 2, Slovan Bratislava 0.
Delay in match because of an injury Lorenzo Pellegrini (Roma).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Roma. Matías Soulé replaces Lorenzo Pellegrini because of an injury.
Goal! Roma 3, Slovan Bratislava 0. Niccolò Pisilli (Roma) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the top left corner. Assisted by Donyell Malen.
Substitution, Slovan Bratislava. Alasana Yirajang replaces Tigran Barseghyan.
Goal! Roma 4, Slovan Bratislava 0. Donyell Malen (Roma) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the bottom left corner.
Substitution, Roma. Santiago Castro replaces Donyell Malen.
Substitution, Roma. Devyne Rensch replaces Wesley.

Delay over. They are ready to continue.
